selected_after: Initial colour-signal run: changing pre-exposure violates same-code hypotheses in both PQ packings and one sRGB frame; retain those failures
purpose: Distinguish steady inputs from pre-exposure transitions, and test whether per-frame reset removes the observed discrepancy
fixed_controls: Linear and both non-linear packings at pre=0.5 and pre=2, each held constant for all three frames
reset_controls: sRGB/PQ in each packing with the original 0.5,1,2 pre-exposure sequence, resetting all three frames
interpretation: Compare reset/static controls with the initial continuous transitions. Even causal reset dependence does not identify internal decode/pre-exposure ordering or prove a wrapper bug.
